images.title: The torch beam is a ray
images.purpose: Show that a ray starts at one point and goes on in one direction, named with its start first.
images.composition: A single horizontal beam from T through L, arrowhead at the right, nothing else.
images.exact_structure: A dot T on the left, then a dot L to its right on the same level. One teal #0072B2 line from T through L continuing to the right edge with an arrowhead. T is shown as a larger amber #E69F00 dot, the starting point. Exactly 1 ray, 2 dots, 1 arrowhead at the right only.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
an arrowhead at the left end
images.takeaway: A ray has one starting point and goes on one way.
images.description: A teal ray starting at amber point T, passing point L and continuing to the right with an arrowhead.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the start and say ray TL.

image_decisions.why: The idea is a picture idea; one clean image carries it.
